reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: Staff was great, doctor was great, pricing was about standard which was a pleasant surprise to find in La Jolla. Stuart S.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: I took my Cat there for a tooth removal and they were all so nice and caring. I felt very comfortable leaving my cat there even for the whole day. She's much better now and I couldn't be more thankful. Abiana V.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: Dr. Vineyard and her staff are exceptional. We were clients for 3 years before my nearly 15 year old Puggle, Diesel, passed. From the front desk with a chalkboard welcoming your pet’s visit to the technicians in the back, they all obviously enjoy their jobs and love our fur babies. They were extremely kind and empathic when my dog became ill and I was a slobbering devastated mess. Dr. Vineyard was the best veterinarian my family ever had and we had been to many on both coasts. Justine L.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: Colony Veterinary Hospital has taken such great care of my Golden Retriever. They are thorough and really take their time to listen to what is going on with your pet. Their prices are affordable and they work very hard to get your pet scheduled the same day if there is an issue and you want to be seen. Joseph D.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: I recently moved to LA to San Diego and are so happy we found colony vet hospital for our pup! I was very nervous as our dog has extreme anxiety both when meeting new people and going to the vet - I made the staff aware of this before and they were so incredibly patient with her & knew exactly how to interact with her. Amanda M.
